name: stocksense
description: StockSense - Modular Inventory Management System (frontend + backend)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && node scripts/init-env.mjs && npm run setup --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
